LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Enlist_Letter_Label: Welcome to the crew. Rules are simple: you pull your weight, you get paid, and you don't ask where the caps came from. Provisions and gear are yours to draw whenever the gang's holding a camp.\n\n Don't screw us and we won't screw you.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Enlist_Button_Desc: Throw in with this raider gang.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Satis: You need to have minimum of -10 goodwill, currently you have only {0} goodwill.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Menu_Missions_Desc: Someone in the gang's looking for an extra pair of hands, no questions asked.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Salary_Desc: You are entitled to collect your cut from this gang every 10 days.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Provisions_Desc:
Provisions will arrive via your caravan inventory every 12 days:

- Survival meals
- Industrial medicine
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Storage_Desc: Store items from your caravan to your gang's stash. Stashes transfer across all of the gang's camps and will save contents even if you are no longer enlisted.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Muscle_Work_Desc: Lean on people for the gang for $12 an hour.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Patch_Job_Desc: Get patched up by whoever passes for a medic around here. This service tends to all of your team with industrial medicine. Immunity gain is also increased while your team is under care.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Gang_Drills_Desc:
Train alongside the gang with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Shooting, Melee

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Resign_Menu_Text: You will resign from the gang effective immediately. (-15 in relations)
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Resign_Button_Label: You have successfully resigned from the gang. (-15 relations)
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Faction: cannot join because you are enlisted with their enemy, {HOSTILEFACTION_name}
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The gang's cut you loose. You have been let go from the {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.FCP_Raiders_Reinforcements_Button_Desc: Call for reinforcements from your gang. Amount they send depends on your current relations.
